title: KCP space_participant_add request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Proposes a SpaceParticipant (§10.2; the §11.6.1 family names participant proposal). participant_id, authority_source_ref, status, and revision are server-derived (gap notes KG5/KG19); activation is the separate operator operation. Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal (assurance: current login). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Caller-suppliable SpaceParticipant fields (§10.2 record shape, names verbatim; gap note KG19). Participation supplies addressability and role presentation, never execution authority (§10.2).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

participantKind.description: Closed SpaceParticipant.kind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); a peer projection can never act as a local actor (§10.2).

participantRole.description: Closed SpaceParticipant.role enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); participation supplies addressability and role presentation, not authority (§10.2).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
